<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/quote-split.ts -->
<!--
  Testimonials in a split or with figures. Axes: layout (media: one quote card and an action beside a picture,
  logos: one quote over four logo tiles beside a picture, rating: one quote beside a rating panel, stack: three
  stacked quote cards beside a picture, compact: four short quote cards in a row, bento: figures over a featured
  quote beside a stack), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { QuoteExtras } from "./quote-split.types";
import type { Quote, QuoteLabels } from "./testimonial-grid.types";
import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
import type { Logo } from "./logo-cloud.types";
import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

export type QuoteSplitProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  badge?: string;
  quotes: Quote[];
  labels: QuoteLabels;
  extras: QuoteExtras;
  actions: LinkActions;
  layout?: "media" | "logos" | "rating" | "stack" | "compact" | "bento";
  mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import QuoteFigures from "../components/quote-figures.vue";
import QuoteLogoTiles from "../components/quote-logo-tiles.vue";
import QuoteRatingPanel from "../components/quote-rating-panel.vue";
import QuoteSlot from "../components/quote-slot.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  badge = "",
  quotes,
  labels,
  extras,
  actions,
  layout = "media",
  mediaSide = "end",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<QuoteSplitProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame v-if="(((layout as string) === 'compact') || ((layout as string) === 'bento'))"
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <QuoteFigures v-if="((layout as string) === 'bento')" :extras="extras" />
    <Box
      :class="
        (layout as string) === 'bento' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2'
        : 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4'
      "
    >
      <QuoteSlot v-for="(q, i) in quotes" :key="q.id"
        :q="q"
        :labels="labels"
        :layout="((((layout as string) === 'bento') && (i === 0)) ? 'single' : 'grid')"
        :class="((((layout as string) === 'bento') && (i === 0)) ? 'lg:row-span-3' : '')"
      />
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
  <SectionFrame v-else
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge }"
    :tone="tone"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true, side: mediaSide }"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <template v-if="(((layout as string) === 'media') || ((layout as string) === 'logos') || ((layout as string) === 'rating'))">
      <template v-for="(q, i) in quotes" :key="q.id">
        <QuoteSlot v-if="(i < 1)"
          :q="q"
          :labels="labels"
          :kind="(((layout as string) === 'media') ? 'card' : 'plain')"
          layout="single"
          class=""
        />
      </template>
    </template>
    <QuoteLogoTiles v-if="((layout as string) === 'logos')" :extras="extras" />
    <Stack v-if="((layout as string) === 'stack')" gap="4" align="stretch">
      <template v-for="(q, i) in quotes" :key="q.id">
        <QuoteSlot v-if="(i < 3)" :q="q" :labels="labels" layout="stack" class="" />
      </template>
    </Stack>
    <ActionGroup v-if="(((layout as string) === 'media') || ((layout as string) === 'logos') || ((layout as string) === 'rating'))"
      :primary="actions.cta"
      :primaryHref="actions.href"
      :secondary="((actions.mode === 'two') ? actions.secondary : undefined)"
      :secondaryHref="actions.secondaryHref"
    />
    <template #aside>
      <QuoteRatingPanel v-if="((layout as string) === 'rating')" :extras="extras" :labels="labels" />
      <MediaFrame v-else :alt="title" ratio="4/3" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
